what_happened: Discovered during research: roughly a dozen extension implementation agents (lean, rust, typst, books, web, python, z3, nix, nvim, latex, and likely cslib/founder/epi) call git-commit-scoped.sh DIRECTLY for their per-phase commits (with --task {N} already passed for the V5 overlap check), and their own prose still instructs 'run the Phase-Commit Containment Self-Check (see general-implementation-agent.md's #### Phase-Commit Containment Self-Check)'. That section has since been mechanized ONLY inside git-commit-phase.sh, which none of these agents call -- so the cross-reference now points at dead prose and these ~12 agents' phase commits have NO Containment protection today, confirming the still-open gap this task's evidence file (specs/archive/336.../evidence/03_followup-mechanical-check.md) predicted.

Planning found three gaps in the research report's recommended design that would each have produced a live regression if implemented as written: (1) no path normalization — orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh and redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh both pass ABSOLUTE pathspecs ($TASK_DIR/, $STATE_FILE, TODO.md) while file_scope entries are repo-relative, so a naive string predicate would drop every carve-out path on every orchestrate cycle; (2) the report omits orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh WORK (h)'s derived-output-prefix widening (derived_probe_output_prefixes), so the inner check would silently reverse an exemption the layer above deliberately grants; (3) the report's claim that an all-dropped shape 'folds into existing exit 4 (V6)' is wrong — V3's post-filter refusal fires first and yields exit 2. Plan corrects all three explicitly.

V9's existing per-pathspec parent-only realpath result (p_dir_rel) can be reused verbatim to normalize a pathspec for the new Containment predicate — no extra realpath call, and symlink-leaf safety is inherited rather than re-derived. task-lookup-lib.sh's task_lookup_dir already resolves the implicit own-task-directory member and is already present in the test harness's REQUIRED_SCRIPTS.

Full gate-set run (verify-deploy.sh + run-all.sh) surfaced two pre-existing, unrelated failing suites not caused by this task's 3-file edit: (1) test-run-all-selection.sh's case1/case1b/case3 -- suite-selection-lib.sh's current grep-based stratum-(b) resolution for lib/common.sh returns the full list of referencing suites, never the FULL_SWEEP sentinel the test expects (no hit-count-to-full-sweep escalation exists in the current implementation); neither file was touched by this task or any commit of it. (2) test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh's cold-baseline/negative-case assertions -- gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep against the live specs/state.json, now large) consistently exceeds the fixture's hardcoded 30s bound, reproduced even under low concurrent system load. Both are reported here per dispatch-report-not-termination discipline rather than silently ignored; this task's own declared file_scope (git-commit-scoped.sh, git-staging-scope.md, test-git-commit-scoped.sh) and test-git-commit-phase.sh are confirmed green.
